parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables/disables this group object instance. If any User which belongs to a Group which becomes disabled is currently accessing the device then the effect on that User should be as if the Group were removed from that User's GroupParticipation list.

parameters.name: GroupID
parameters.description: Unique Identifier of the group. Depending on the implementation this can be the unique identifier assigned by the underlying system.

parameters.name: Groupname
parameters.description: Name of the Group. MUST NOT be {{empty}} for an enabled entry.

parameters.name: RoleParticipation
parameters.description: These Roles are assigned to any User which is member of this Group, for so long as they remain a member of the Group.

parameters.name: StaticGroup
parameters.description: A static group is a fixed group that is always available in the system. When set to {{true}}, the group cannot be removed.

object.description: This object contains parameters relating to the characteristics of a user group.
